cases.d: Verify the Secretary uploads three PDFs and a DOCX into the meeting and their library folder.
steps: As the Secretary, POST /api/meetings/<id>/documents/upload as multipart/form-data with files "Báo cáo Q3.pdf" (pageCounts 12), "Tờ trình.pdf" (3), "Phụ lục.pdf" (no count) and "Dự thảo.docx" (7).
Open the Secretary's personal library.
exp: HTTP 201 Created with code "MSG161" ("Đã thêm tài liệu vào cuộc họp.") and addedCount 4.
The four documents appear in the meeting with their names and page counts.
The same four are in the Secretary's library, in a folder named after the meeting.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.
File storage (SeaweedFS or R2) is configured.

cases.d: Verify the Chair may upload documents too.
steps: As the Chair of a Draft meeting, upload a.pdf.
exp: HTTP 201 with code "MSG161".
pre: A Draft meeting and its Chair signed in.

cases.d: Verify a file that is not really a PDF or DOCX rejects the whole submission.
steps: Upload ok.pdf together with: anh.pdf (a PNG image renamed); then macro.docx (a macro-enabled Word file); then broken.docx (a DOCX without its document part).
exp: Each upload returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG164" and an error for the bad file.
ok.pdf is not added either; storage is unchanged.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify eleven files are over the submission limit.
steps: Upload 11 PDF files in one request.
exp: HTTP 400 with code "MSG288" ("Mỗi lần tải tối đa 10 tệp, tổng dung lượng không quá 200 MB.").
Nothing is added.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a request declaring more than 200 MB is refused before it is read.
steps: Upload one file big.pdf of 202 MB.
exp: HTTP 400 with code "MSG288".
Nothing is stored.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a single file over 50 MB is invalid.
steps: Upload lon.pdf of 50 MB + 1 byte.
exp: HTTP 400 with code "MSG164".
errors.files[0] mentions "50 MB".
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify an upload with no file or a body that is not multipart is invalid.
steps: POST a multipart body with only a pageCounts field.
POST a JSON body {}.
exp: Both return HTTP 400 with code "MSG164".
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a Member or an organizer without a managing role is refused and an outsider gets 404.
steps: Upload a.pdf as the Member, as the organizer (not Chair or Secretary) and as an outsider.
exp: Member and organizer: HTTP 403 with code "MSG162" ("Bạn không còn quyền thêm tài liệu ...").
Outsider: HTTP 404 with code "MSG156".
pre: A Published meeting with organizer, Chair, Secretary and Member.

cases.d: Verify a removed Secretary loses access and a deactivated Chair is refused.
steps: Remove the Secretary from the roster and deactivate the Chair.
Upload a file as each.
exp: The removed Secretary gets HTTP 404 (or 403 "MSG162").
The deactivated Chair gets HTTP 403.
pre: A Draft meeting with Chair and Secretary.

cases.d: Verify an Ended meeting refuses uploads.
steps: As the Secretary of an Ended meeting, upload a.pdf.
exp: HTTP 409 with code "MSG172" ("Không thể thêm tài liệu sau khi cuộc họp đã kết thúc.").
Nothing is stored.
pre: An Ended meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a Cancelled meeting refuses uploads.
steps: As the Secretary of a Cancelled meeting, upload a.pdf.
exp: HTTP 409 with code "MSG349" ("Cuộc họp đã huỷ nên không thay đổi được nữa.").
Nothing is stored.
pre: A Cancelled meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a meeting that ends while files upload refuses them and deletes the stored objects.
steps: Start a large upload as the Secretary.
While it is uploading, end the meeting as the Chair.
exp: The upload returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG172".
The objects written to storage are deleted; nothing is added.
pre: An InProgress meeting with Chair and Secretary.

cases.d: Verify a Secretary who loses the role during an upload is refused and the objects are deleted.
steps: Start a large upload as the Secretary.
Meanwhile change the Secretary's seat to Member.
exp: The upload returns HTTP 403 with code "MSG162".
The written objects are deleted; nothing is added.
pre: A Published meeting with Secretary.

cases.d: Verify a Member sending an invalid file is refused for the role, not the file.
steps: As the Member, upload anh.pdf (a PNG image renamed).
exp: HTTP 403 with code "MSG162" (not MSG164).
pre: A Published meeting with a Member.

cases.d: Verify HTML disguised with a PDF marker and a mismatched file name are rejected.
steps: Upload poly.pdf whose content is HTML with a script and a %PDF comment, together with that.html that is really a PDF.
exp: HTTP 400 with code "MSG164" with errors for files[0] and files[1].
Nothing is stored.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a storage failure on the second file deletes the first and adds nothing.
steps: Make the storage fail on the second write (stop SeaweedFS after the first file).
Upload a.pdf and b.pdf.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG166".
a.pdf is removed from storage; no document is added.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a database failure after the files are stored deletes every stored file.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL right after the files reach storage.
Upload a.pdf and b.docx.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG166".
Both objects are deleted from storage; no document is added.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify MSG166 is still returned when the cleanup cannot delete the files.
steps: Make both the database save and the storage delete fail.
Upload a.pdf.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG166".
No meeting document row exists; the left-over object is marked for the orphan purge.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify every stored object already has its database row when it is written.
steps: Upload a.pdf and b.pdf while watching the stored_files table.
exp: HTTP 201.
Both stored_files rows exist before their objects are written.
pre: A Published meeting on PostgreSQL.

cases.d: Verify a page-count part longer than a number is malformed and other parts are skipped.
steps: Upload a.pdf with an extra 1 MB text part "notes" and an extra file part "attachment".
Upload a.pdf with a pageCounts value longer than a number.
exp: The first upload returns HTTP 201 with addedCount 1 (extra parts are ignored).
The second returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG164".
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a body with more parts than any real upload is malformed.
steps: POST a multipart body with 65 empty pageCounts parts.
exp: HTTP 400 with code "MSG164".
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify uploads return MSG166 when no file storage is configured.
steps: Remove the FileStorage settings and restart the backend.
Upload a.pdf.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG166".
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify later uploads reuse the meeting folder even renamed or moved, and recreate it once deleted.
steps: Upload a.pdf; rename and move the meeting folder in the library; upload again.
Delete the folder (after emptying it) and upload again.
exp: The second upload goes into the same (renamed, moved) folder.
After deletion a new meeting folder is created once.
pre: A Published meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify the agenda editor lists uploaded documents for linking.
steps: Upload a.pdf to a Draft meeting.
GET /api/meetings/<id>/agenda/editor-options.
exp: The uploaded document is listed among the documents that can be linked to an agenda item.
pre: A Draft meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a Member sees documents grouped by agenda item in order, with general documents and without removed ones.
steps: As the Member, GET /api/meetings/<id>/documents.
exp: HTTP 200 OK.
agendaItems are in agenda order; "Tờ trình.pdf" appears under items 1 and 3 with 12 pages and 2 comments; "Báo cáo.pdf" under item 2.
general lists documents not linked to any item.
Removed documents are not listed; currentAgendaItemId is item 2.
pre: A Published meeting with three agenda items (Done, InProgress, Pending) and documents as described, one of them removed.

cases.d: Verify a meeting without documents returns empty groups and no current item.
exp: HTTP 200 OK.
currentAgendaItemId is null; agendaItems and general are empty.
pre: A Published meeting with no agenda and no documents; thanhvien is invited.

cases.d: Verify the documents of an Ended meeting stay readable.
steps: As the Member, GET the document list and the content of "Biên bản.pdf".
exp: The list contains the document.
The content is returned byte for byte.
pre: An Ended meeting with "Biên bản.pdf".

cases.d: Verify a caller who cannot view the meeting gets the same 404 as for a missing meeting.
steps: As an outsider, GET the document list and the content of "Mật.pdf", and the list of a random meeting id.
As a Member of a Draft meeting, GET its document list.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 404 with code "MSG156" and the same body.
pre: A Published meeting with "Mật.pdf" and a Draft meeting with a Member.

cases.d: Verify a list read failure returns MSG157, not an empty list.
exp: HTTP 500 with code "MSG157" ("Không tải được danh sách tài liệu. Vui lòng thử lại.").
pre: thanhvien is invited to a Published meeting.
The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify viewing streams the stored bytes unchanged as an attachment.
exp: HTTP 200 OK.
The body is exactly the uploaded file.
Content-Type is application/pdf and Content-Disposition names "Báo cáo quý 3.pdf".
pre: A Published meeting with "Báo cáo quý 3.pdf"; thanhvien is invited.

cases.d: Verify documents of a Secret meeting can be viewed and are audited but cannot be downloaded.
steps: As the Member, GET the content of "Tuyệt mật.pdf".
GET it with ?download=true.
exp: Viewing returns the bytes and writes one document.viewed audit entry.
Downloading is refused (HTTP 403) and nothing is downloaded.
pre: A Secret meeting with "Tuyệt mật.pdf"; the Member is invited.

cases.d: Verify downloading a document of a Confidential meeting is audited.
steps: As the organizer, GET the content of "Hạn chế.pdf" with ?download=true.
exp: The file is downloaded unchanged.
One document.downloaded audit entry is written.
pre: A Confidential meeting with "Hạn chế.pdf".

cases.d: Verify a removed document and a document of another meeting return MSG156.
steps: As the Member, GET the content of the removed "Đã gỡ.pdf".
GET this meeting's URL with the id of "Họp khác.pdf" from another meeting.
exp: Both return HTTP 404 with code "MSG156".
pre: Two Published meetings as described.

cases.d: Verify a Secret download checks the document belongs here before refusing, and refuses before touching storage.
steps: With ?download=true, as the Member GET: a removed document, a document of another Secret meeting, a document whose file is missing from storage, and a normal document.
exp: Removed and foreign documents return HTTP 404 with code "MSG156".
The other two are refused as Secret downloads without reading storage.
pre: Two Secret meetings with documents as described.

cases.d: Verify a lookup failure returns MSG158 when viewing and MSG160 when downloading.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL.
GET the content of "Báo cáo.pdf", then with ?download=true.
exp: Viewing returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG158".
Downloading returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG160" ("Không tải về được tài liệu. Vui lòng thử lại.").
pre: A Published meeting with "Báo cáo.pdf"; the Member is signed in.

cases.d: Verify a missing stored file returns MSG158 / MSG160 and is not audited.
steps: Delete the object of "Mất.pdf" from storage.
GET its content, then with ?download=true.
Remove the storage configuration and GET again.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG158" (view) or "MSG160" (download).
No audit entry is written.
pre: A Confidential meeting with "Mất.pdf".

cases.d: Verify the content is withheld when the audit entry cannot be written.
steps: Make writing the audit log fail.
As the Member, GET the content of "Mật.pdf".
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG158".
No content is returned and no audit entry exists.
pre: A Secret meeting with "Mật.pdf".

cases.d: Verify an upload notifies only readers who joined this meeting.
steps: The Member joins this meeting's hub; a member of another meeting joins theirs; the Chair connects but does not join.
As the Secretary, upload a document.
exp: Only the Member receives documentsChanged.
pre: Two Published meetings.

cases.d: Verify the Secretary adds own library documents as general documents under their current name.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the meeting Secretary>
req.body: { "documentIds": ["<id of Tờ trình.pdf>", "<id of Phụ lục.docx>", "<id of Tờ trình.pdf>"] }

exp: HTTP 201 with code "MSG161" and addedCount 2 (the duplicate is ignored).
Both appear as general documents under their current library names.
pre: The Secretary's library holds "Tờ trình.pdf" and "Phụ lục.docx".

cases.d: Verify the library selection must be the actor's own, available and not yet in the meeting.
steps: As the Chair, POST /documents with documentIds []; with the Member's a.pdf; with own a.pdf twice in a row; with a deleted library document.
exp: Empty, someone else's or deleted documents return HTTP 400 with code "MSG249".
A document already in the meeting is not added again.
pre: The Chair's library holds a.pdf; the Member's holds b.pdf.

cases.d: Verify adding from the library is for the current Chair or Secretary until the meeting ends.
steps: As the Member, add their a.pdf.
As an outsider, add b.pdf.
As the Secretary, add c.pdf; end the meeting and try again.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 with code "MSG162"; outsider: HTTP 404.
Secretary before the end: HTTP 201 with code "MSG161"; after the end: HTTP 409 with code "MSG172".
pre: A Published meeting; each user has one library document.

cases.d: Verify the Chair removes a document, keeping its comments, and it leaves every list.
steps: The Member joins the meeting hub.
As the Chair, DELETE /api/meetings/<id>/documents/<document id>.
GET the document list and the agenda.
exp: The removal succeeds.
The document is gone from the list and from the agenda item; its comment "Góp ý" is kept in the database.
The Member receives documentsChanged.
pre: A meeting document linked to an agenda item and with one comment.

cases.d: Verify adding a removed file again creates a new document without the old comments.
steps: Add "Lại.pdf" from the library and comment on it.
Remove it from the meeting.
Add "Lại.pdf" again.
exp: The second add creates a new meeting document with a new id.
It has no comments; the old comments stay with the removed document.
pre: The Secretary's library holds "Lại.pdf".

cases.d: Verify removal is refused to others, after the end, for another meeting's document and on failure.
steps: As the Member, remove a document.
As the Secretary, remove a document of another meeting.
Stop PostgreSQL and remove; restart, end the meeting and remove.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 with code "MSG169".
Other meeting's document: HTTP 404 with code "MSG170".
Database down: HTTP 503; after the end: HTTP 409 with code "MSG172".
pre: Two Published meetings with documents.

cases.d: Verify the Chair links meeting documents to an item, keeping their other links.
steps: As the Chair, POST /api/meetings/<id>/agenda/<item 1>/documents with { "documentIds": ["<a.pdf>"] }.
POST /agenda/<item 2>/documents with { "documentIds": ["<a.pdf>", "<b.pdf>"] }.
exp: Both return HTTP 200 with code "MSG238" ("Đã gắn tài liệu vào mục nghị sự.").
a.pdf is linked to both items; b.pdf to item 2.
pre: A meeting with two agenda items and documents a.pdf and b.pdf.

cases.d: Verify linking checks the item and that every document is still in the meeting, all or none.
steps: Remove b.pdf from the meeting.
Link a.pdf to an item of another meeting.
Link a.pdf and the removed b.pdf to an item of this meeting.
exp: Another meeting's item: HTTP 404 with code "MSG242" ("Hãy chọn một mục nghị sự còn trong cuộc họp này.").
With the removed document: HTTP 404 with code "MSG170" and a.pdf is not linked either.
pre: Two meetings with agenda items; this one has a.pdf and b.pdf.

cases.d: Verify linking is refused to others, after the end and on failure.
steps: As the Member, link a document.
As the Secretary, link with the database failing; then end the meeting and link.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 with code "MSG240".
Database failure: HTTP 503; after the end: HTTP 409 with code "MSG172".
pre: A Published meeting with an agenda item and a document.

cases.d: Verify adding from the library to an item adds it to the meeting and links it in one go.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the meeting Chair>

exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG238".
"Từ kho.pdf" is a new meeting document linked to the item.
pre: The Chair's library holds "Từ kho.pdf"; the meeting has an agenda item.

cases.d: Verify an upload into an item past the storage limit adds nothing.
steps: Fill the system storage until only 10 bytes are free.
As the Secretary, upload x.pdf into an agenda item.
exp: HTTP 409 with code "MSG346" (storage is full).
No meeting document and no link is added.
pre: FileStorage:MaxTotalGigabytes is set so the limit can be reached.

cases.d: Verify an upload into an item adds it to the library folder, the meeting and the item.
steps: As the Secretary, upload "Tải thẳng.pdf" (2 pages) to /api/meetings/<id>/agenda/<item>/documents/upload.
exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG238".
The file is in the Secretary's meeting folder, in the meeting and linked to the item.
pre: A meeting with an agenda item and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify unlinking drops one link and the document stays in the meeting.
steps: Link a document to items 1 and 2.
As the Chair, DELETE /agenda/<item 1>/documents/<document id>.
exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG239" ("Đã gỡ tài liệu khỏi mục nghị sự.").
The document is still linked to item 2 and still in the meeting.
pre: A meeting with two agenda items and a document.

cases.d: Verify unlinking is refused to others, for a removed document, an unknown item, after the end and on failure.
steps: As the Member, unlink.
As the Secretary, unlink the removed b.pdf, unlink from an unknown item, unlink with the database down, and unlink after the meeting ends.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 with code "MSG241".
Removed document: HTTP 404 with code "MSG170"; unknown item: HTTP 404 with code "MSG242".
Database down: HTTP 503; after the end: HTTP 409 with code "MSG172".
pre: A Published meeting with a linked a.pdf and a removed b.pdf.

cases.d: Verify every document change is refused once the meeting is cancelled.
steps: Cancel the meeting.
As the Secretary, upload, add from the library, remove, link and unlink.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG349".
pre: A meeting with an item, a linked document and a library document.

cases.d: Verify every document change tells the meeting room to reload its documents.
steps: The Member joins the meeting hub.
As the Secretary, add from the library, link, unlink, upload into the item and remove.
exp: The Member receives one documentsChanged event for each change.
pre: A meeting with an agenda item and two library documents.

cases.d: Verify changes are refused to a removed manager, another meeting's Chair and a deactivated account.
steps: Remove the Chair from the roster and try to add, link and remove.
As the Chair of another meeting, try the same.
Deactivate the Secretary and try the same.
exp: Every request is refused (HTTP 403 or 404); nothing changes.
pre: Two meetings with documents and agenda items.

cases.d: Verify a Member comments on a PDF page and a DOCX comment has no page.
steps: As the Member, POST /api/meetings/<id>/documents/<pdf id>/comments with { "body": " Xem lại số liệu ", "pageNumber": 3 }.
POST a comment on the DOCX with pageNumber 3.
exp: Both return HTTP 201 with code "MSG199" ("Đã gửi góp ý.").
The PDF comment is "Xem lại số liệu" on page 3.
The DOCX comment has no page number.
pre: A Published meeting with a PDF and a DOCX; the Member is invited.

cases.d: Verify a reply to a reply joins the thread of the top-level comment.
steps: As the Member, post "Gốc" on page 2.
As the Chair, reply to it; as the Member, reply to the Chair's reply.
exp: Both replies belong to the thread of "Gốc" and keep page 2.
pre: A Published meeting with a PDF.

cases.d: Verify a comment must have text within the length limit.
steps: Post { "body": " " }.
Post a body of 4001 characters.
exp: Blank: HTTP 400 with code "MSG200" ("Hãy nhập nội dung góp ý.").
Too long: HTTP 400 with code "MSG348" ("Nội dung vượt quá độ dài cho phép.").
pre: A Published meeting with a document.

cases.d: Verify comments become read-only once the meeting has ended.
steps: As the Member, post "Muộn".
GET the comments.
exp: Posting returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG251".
Reading returns HTTP 200 with canComment false.
pre: An Ended meeting with a document.

cases.d: Verify comments become read-only once the meeting is cancelled.
steps: As the Member, post a comment; GET the comments.
exp: Posting returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG349".
Reading still works with canComment false.
pre: A meeting cancelled after it was Published, with a document.

cases.d: Verify the organizer and the approver comment like anyone who can view the meeting.
steps: As the organizer and as the assigned approver (not on the roster), post a comment.
exp: Both return HTTP 201 with code "MSG199".
pre: A Published meeting with a document and an assigned approver.

cases.d: Verify outsiders, removed documents and other meetings' documents get the same answer.
steps: As an outsider, read and post comments.
Remove the document; as the Member, read and post.
As the Member, use this meeting's URL with another meeting's document id.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 404 with code "MSG156".
pre: Two Published meetings with documents.

cases.d: Verify the same file in two meetings has two separate discussions.
steps: Add the same library file to two meetings.
Comment on it in the first meeting; read the comments in the second.
exp: The second meeting shows no comments.
pre: Two Published meetings; the Secretary owns the file.

cases.d: Verify failures to save or load comments answer their own codes.
steps: Make the save fail and post "Lỗi".
Stop PostgreSQL and read the comments.
exp: Saving returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG202".
Reading returns an error code instead of an empty list.
pre: A Published meeting with a document.

cases.d: Verify the owner creates nested folders, duplicate names are allowed and they show in the library.
steps: POST /api/folders with { "name": " Báo cáo " }.
POST /api/folders with { "name": "Quý 3", "parentId": "<id of Báo cáo>" } twice.
GET the library.
exp: Each create returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG187" ("Đã tạo thư mục."); the name is trimmed to "Báo cáo".
Two subfolders "Quý 3" exist under "Báo cáo".
pre: Signed in as an active user.

cases.d: Verify a folder name must not be blank or too long.
steps: POST /api/folders with { "name": " " }.
POST with a name of 401 characters.
exp: Blank: HTTP 400 with code "MSG188" ("Hãy nhập tên thư mục.").
Too long: HTTP 400 with code "MSG348".
pre: Signed in as an active user.

cases.d: Verify someone else's folder cannot be a parent, renamed or deleted.
steps: Create a folder under another user's "Riêng".
PUT /api/folders/<Riêng>/name, PUT /api/folders/<Riêng>/parent, DELETE /api/folders/<Riêng>.
exp: As parent: HTTP 404 with code "MSG179".
Rename, move and delete: HTTP 404 with code "MSG175".
pre: Another user owns the folder "Riêng".

cases.d: Verify a sixth folder level is refused on create and on move.
steps: Create folders "Cấp 1" to "Cấp 5" nested.
Create a folder inside "Cấp 5".
Move "Có con" (which has a subfolder) into "Cấp 4".
exp: Both return HTTP 409 with code "MSG189" (folders nest at most 5 levels).
pre: Signed in as an active user.

cases.d: Verify a folder cannot move into itself or a subfolder but can move to the root.
steps: Move "Gốc" into itself, into "Con", into "Cháu".
Move "Con" to the root ({ "parentId": null }).
exp: The first three return HTTP 409 with code "MSG193".
The move to the root succeeds.
pre: Folders Gốc > Con > Cháu exist.

cases.d: Verify two crossing moves at once never make a cycle.
steps: At the same time, move A into B and B into A.
exp: Exactly one move succeeds; the other is refused.
No folder is its own ancestor.
pre: Two root folders A and B.

cases.d: Verify renaming a folder keeps its place and contents.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the folder owner>

exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG191" ("Đã đổi tên thư mục.").
The folder is named "Mới", stays in the same place and still contains a.pdf.
pre: The owner has folder "Cũ" containing a.pdf.

cases.d: Verify only an empty folder can be deleted.
steps: DELETE "Có tài liệu" (contains a document), "Có con" (contains a folder), then "Rỗng" (empty) twice.
exp: The first two return HTTP 409 with code "MSG196" ("Chỉ xoá được thư mục rỗng.").
"Rỗng" is deleted (HTTP 200, "MSG197"); the second delete returns HTTP 404 with code "MSG175".
pre: The owner has the three folders described.

cases.d: Verify folder changes that cannot be saved answer their own codes.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL.
Create a folder, rename one, move one, delete one.
exp: Create: HTTP 503 with code "MSG190".
Rename: HTTP 503 with code "MSG192".
Move and delete answer their own 503 codes; nothing changes.
pre: The owner has the folder "Thư mục".

cases.d: Verify the owner uploads into a folder and sees the documents and the storage used.
steps: POST /api/documents/upload?folderId=<Hồ sơ> with "Tờ trình.pdf" (3 pages) and "Dự thảo.docx".
GET the library at that folder.
exp: HTTP 201 with code "MSG177" ("Đã tải tài liệu lên kho của bạn.") and addedCount 2.
Both documents are listed in "Hồ sơ"; the storage used increases by their size.
pre: The owner has the folder "Hồ sơ".

cases.d: Verify the library upload checks the destination, the files and the limits.
steps: Upload into another user's folder.
Upload to the root.
Upload 11 files; upload a PNG renamed .pdf.
exp: Another user's folder: HTTP 404 with code "MSG179".
Root: HTTP 201 with code "MSG177".
11 files: HTTP 400 with code "MSG288"; fake PDF: HTTP 400 with code "MSG164".
pre: Signed in as an active user.

cases.d: Verify an upload past the storage limit adds nothing.
steps: Fill the system storage until only 10 bytes are free.
Upload a.pdf to the library.
exp: HTTP 409 with code "MSG346".
Nothing is stored.
pre: FileStorage:MaxTotalGigabytes is set so the limit can be reached.

cases.d: Verify the storage limit is the whole system's, whoever filled it.
steps: Another user fills the storage to 10 bytes free.
As a meeting Secretary, upload x.pdf to the meeting.
exp: HTTP 409 with code "MSG346".
No meeting document is added.
pre: FileStorage:MaxTotalGigabytes is set so the limit can be reached.

cases.d: Verify two uploads at once near the limit let only one in.
steps: Leave room for 1.5 copies of x.pdf.
Upload x.pdf twice at the same time.
exp: One upload returns HTTP 201 and the other HTTP 409 with code "MSG346".
pre: FileStorage:MaxTotalGigabytes is set so the limit can be reached.

cases.d: Verify a refused upload gives its reserved room back.
steps: Stop the file storage.
Upload r.pdf; check the storage used.
exp: HTTP 503.
The storage used is the same as before.
pre: Signed in as an active user.

cases.d: Verify a failed store adds nothing and leaves no object.
steps: Make the storage fail on the second file.
Upload a.pdf and b.pdf.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG178".
a.pdf is removed from storage; no document is added.
pre: Signed in as an active user.

cases.d: Verify search and the type filter stay within the current location.
steps: At the root, search "Báo cáo".
Filter the root by type pdf.
Search "100%".
exp: The root search finds "Báo cáo quý 3.pdf" and "Báo cáo quý 4.docx" but not the one inside "Thư mục".
The pdf filter shows only PDFs.
"100%" finds "100%_xong.pdf" (% is matched literally).
pre: The owner has the four documents described.

cases.d: Verify the meeting count of a document counts only meetings the owner can view and that still use the file.
steps: Add "Tờ trình.pdf" to a visible meeting, to a meeting the owner cannot view, and to a meeting where it was later removed.
GET the library.
exp: The document shows a meeting count of 1.
pre: The Secretary owns "Tờ trình.pdf".

cases.d: Verify renaming keeps the extension and leaves meeting copies alone.
steps: Add "Cũ.pdf" to a meeting.
PUT /api/documents/<id>/name with { "fileName": "Mới" }.
exp: The library document is "Mới.pdf" (extension kept).
The meeting copy is still "Cũ.pdf".
pre: The Secretary owns "Cũ.pdf".

cases.d: Verify a document moves to an owned folder or the root.
steps: PUT /api/documents/<a.pdf>/folder with { "folderId": "<Đích>" }.
Move it into another user's "Riêng".
Move it to the root (folderId null).
exp: Into "Đích": HTTP 200 with code "MSG185" ("Đã chuyển tài liệu.").
Into "Riêng": HTTP 404 with code "MSG179".
To the root: success.
pre: The owner has a.pdf and the folder "Đích".

cases.d: Verify someone else's document cannot be touched.
steps: Rename, move, open and delete another user's "riêng.pdf".
exp: Every request returns HTTP 404 with code "MSG175".
pre: Another user owns "riêng.pdf".

cases.d: Verify deleting from the library leaves the meeting copy readable.
steps: Add "Tờ trình.pdf" to a meeting.
DELETE /api/documents/<id> from the library.
Open the meeting copy.
exp: The delete returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG180" ("Đã xoá tài liệu khỏi kho của bạn.").
The meeting copy still opens.
pre: The Secretary owns "Tờ trình.pdf".

cases.d: Verify document changes that cannot be saved answer their own codes.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL.
Rename a.pdf to b.pdf; move it; delete it.
exp: Rename: HTTP 503 with code "MSG184" ("Không đổi được tên tài liệu. Tên vẫn giữ nguyên.").
Move: HTTP 503 with code "MSG186".
Delete answers its own 503 code.
pre: The owner has a.pdf.

cases.d: Verify the owner opens their document and a missing file asks to try again.
steps: GET /api/documents/<Đọc.pdf>/content.
Delete its object from storage and GET again.
exp: HTTP 200 with the exact bytes and Content-Disposition attachment.
Missing file: HTTP 503 asking to try again.
pre: The owner has "Đọc.pdf".

cases.d: Verify an administrator reads a deactivated user's library and every read is audited.
steps: As quantri, GET /api/users/<deactivated user>/library?folderId=<Hồ sơ>.
GET /api/users/<user>/library/documents/<Bàn giao.pdf>/content.
exp: Both return HTTP 200 with the folder content and the file.
Each read writes an audit entry.
pre: A deactivated user owns the folder "Hồ sơ" with "Bàn giao.pdf"; signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.

cases.d: Verify nobody reads an active user's library and a non-administrator is refused.
steps: As quantri, GET the library and a document of an active user.
As the Member, GET a deactivated user's library.
exp: The administrator gets HTTP 404 with code "MSG175" for an active user.
The Member is refused (HTTP 403).
pre: An active user with a.pdf and a deactivated user exist.

cases.d: Verify an administrator does not see files or folders of a Secret meeting, even one they can view.
steps: As the Secretary of a Secret meeting, upload "Mật.pdf".
Deactivate the Secretary.
As quantri (also a participant or not), GET the Secretary's library.
exp: The meeting folder and "Mật.pdf" are not shown to the administrator.
Other library content is shown.
pre: A Secret meeting with its Secretary.
